integration: Renamed modules: environment/lighting.ts is now lightPlan.ts, fixtures.ts is fixtureMatrices.ts (no desk block any more), GreyboxLighting.tsx is removed. Parallel WPs that import './environment/lighting' or 'fixtures' must switch to the new names; nothing outside src/museum/environment imported them on this base.
Scene.tsx now mounts Hall, Floor, Fixtures, BrassTrim, Labels, Portrait, Desk and Lighting; ExhibitFrame usage is unchanged. MuseumCanvas.tsx and exhibits/_kit are unchanged.
Lighting reads the store fields tier, settled, stop, track, hovered, openId and reducedMotion (no store shape change).
The portrait loads public/images/headshot-texture-512-duotone.webp and headshot-texture-512.webp (WP-03) through drei useTexture.
deviations: Environment: a 60-line LightformerEnvironment (portal scene, CubeCamera, 256 px half-float cube rendered once, set as scene.environment) instead of drei <Environment frames={1} resolution={256}>. Same behavior, but drei's Environment module bundles the RGBE, EXR and gain-map loaders and the preset CDN URL (raw.githack.com), which the CSP and the no-HDRI rule forbid anyway; dropping it saves 17 KB gzip.

File names: the pure modules got names that differ from their components by more than case (lightPlan.ts vs Lighting.tsx, fixtureMatrices.ts vs Fixtures.tsx, deskParts.ts vs Desk.tsx, BrassTrim.tsx vs trim.ts), so case-insensitive file systems cannot collide. WingRoom, Doors, YearStrips and Foundations from the brief's glob list are covered by Hall (shell geometry), BrassTrim (reveals, strips) and Labels (signs, numerals) rather than separate files.

Pool center: main-aisle plinths shift 0.3 m toward the aisle centerline as specified. Wing plinths, mun and the certifications vitrine have no single aisle line, so their pools shift 0.3 m toward their stop camera.
Side Lightformer panels: the recipe gives color and intensity only; they are 20 x 6 m at x ±10, y 5 so they read as broad side fill instead of bright stripes reflected in the glass cases.
Lightmap levels are code constants in lightPools.ts (floor lightMapIntensity 32 standard, 64 reflector; wall wash 40; floor base 0.05; wash base 0.04), tuned from captures, not tokens.

The tone-mapping captures were taken with the WP-12 Verafin exhibit applied locally and not committed, as R0 allowed, so a real exhibit sits under the light; the AgX token edit was reverted with git checkout.
